propositions: An optional isolated GitHub Actions adapter must parse coverage percentage from pytest-cov TOTAL line in run-log tail and extract CI-health metadata (status, duration, red-to-green recovery time, recheck/flake rate) from run-metadata JSON.

The harvest script must read recent test.yml run logs and metadata via the Actions API, process them through the adapter, and persist labeled snapshots to the git-tracked .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson store (not reports/).
The adapter must remain isolated from core metrics modules; core command imports must not depend on the GitHub Actions adapter to preserve portability.
The snapshot persistence path must be .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson (established store) rather than the CI workflow, since CI has read-only permissions and ephemeral checkouts.
